purpose: Preserve the compact all-design summaries underlying Supplementary Figure S2 and Table S7 without changing the spatial-only historical outputs.

maps_to: Table S7b Delta Aitchison RMSE column
files.source_kind: Display-precision transcription from the unchanged archived historical Table 7 draft, independently matched to the current SM; not an original execution CSV.

Unchanged historical table draft containing all three designs and the reported Aitchison differences/limits; its explanatory prose is an archival record, not a replacement for current manuscript methods.

metric_dictionary.Short/long: Pooled out-of-fold R2 evaluated on the reconstructed, untransformed short-chain/long-chain concentration ratio.
metric_dictionary.Short PFSA/PFCA: Pooled out-of-fold R2 evaluated on the reconstructed, untransformed short-chain PFSA/PFCA concentration ratio.
metric_dictionary.Long PFSA/PFCA: Pooled out-of-fold R2 evaluated on the reconstructed, untransformed long-chain PFSA/PFCA concentration ratio.
metric_dictionary.Aitchison RMSE: Root mean squared Aitchison distance between observed and predicted four-part compositions; it is not a group-ratio-scale RMSE.
metric_dictionary.Delta_R2: Joint multi-output ILR minus separate log-GDR R2, evaluated on untransformed ratios.
metric_dictionary.Delta_Aitchison_RMSE: Joint multi-output ILR minus separate log-GDR Aitchison RMSE in four-part composition space, preserved at the historical table's display precision.
metric_dictionary.CI_lower_and_CI_upper: The reported pointwise 95 percent paired sampling-group bootstrap limits, based on 1000 resamples, for the corresponding Delta_R2 or Delta_Aitchison_RMSE.

historical_spatial_execution_record.interpretation: This remains the actual pre-existing spatial-run record. It is not re-labelled as an execution manifest for all three designs.

boundaries: The figure-source CSVs and historical Table 7 draft are copied byte-for-byte from their archives. The small Aitchison CSV transcribes the three existing table rows; it does not introduce new estimates or intervals.
All three designs and all three representations are covered by the compact performance table, and all three designs and ratios by the paired-R2 table.
The displayed summaries retain their archived precision. They are not full-precision all-design per-observation predictions, model-coordinate metrics or execution manifests.

The paired-R2 figure-source file itself has no Delta_Aitchison_RMSE intervals. The complementary Aitchison CSV recovers the displayed values from the unchanged historical Table 7 draft, not from newly executed models or inferred confidence limits.

No full-precision sampling-grouped or leave-one-group-out original execution CSV or bootstrap distribution was found in the searched historical output archive. Display-precision recovery must not be presented as recovery of those full execution records.
Rounded performance differences need not exactly equal the independently rounded archived Delta_R2 values.
Existing Compositional_Performance_Summary.csv, Compositional_Paired_Bootstrap_Differences.csv and Run_Manifest.json have not been replaced.
